source_evidence: Client fees may include an hourly, fixed or flat fee based on the time an adviser spends providing you with advice or on specific transactions in your account
question: How do hourly, flat, and asset-based advisory fees differ?
answer: Hourly or flat fees may be based on the time an adviser spends giving advice or on specific transactions in your account. Asset-based fees are calculated based on the value of assets in your account and may continue even when there are no transactions.
